notes.title: Chinese (simplified) language now available!
notes.content:
您好!
You can now play Oneiros in Chinese!
I'm happy to announce that Oneiros now features dialogue subtitles and menu texts in Chinese (simplified).
For new players the game should automatically use the correct language, but just in case - you can change the language in Settings -> Game -> Language.
Version 1.3.0 also contains various bug fixes.

Have fun and happy solving!

notes.title: You can now play Oneiros in Turkish!
notes.content:
You can now play Oneiros in Turkish!
I'm happy to announce that Oneiros now features dialogue subtitles and menu texts in Turkish.
You can change the language in Settings -> Game -> Language.
Version 1.2.0 among minor fixes also contains an aid for those of you who struggled too much in the platforms section.
If you die more than 5 times there, a shortcut-exit door will appear next to you. You can take it or ignore it - it's up to you!

Good luck and have fun!
